## D — Your Driver’s License
Accuracy scope: Your Driver’s License facts use the pinned official PDF and one physical page per fact; original phrasing preserves actor qualifications, exceptions and modal verbs.
Physical page eight ends the practice-hour timing clause mid-sentence; page nine continues it. The post-permit issuance timing condition is retained as cross-page verification debt rather than generalized from a single-page fragment. [A08]
The transfer guidance on physical page ten contains both a possible test waiver for valid out-of-state licensees and a categorical passenger-car written-test waiver; the first-time path does not inherit the categorical waiver. [A10]
The currently worded point-warning and point-suspension administrative levels are isolated as update-sensitive verification debt, rather than placed in stable fact blocks. [A14]
The criminal-revocation passage uses indefinite revocation wording beside fixed class-based periods; resolve that wording before teaching an exact duration. [A15]
The practice question suggests automatic police-eluding suspension, whereas the body uses discretionary wording; accepted facts preserve the body’s may and maximum qualifiers. [A13]
Confidence process: every drafted fact received a same-model source-context check before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Officeholders, telephone numbers and changing administrative details are excluded from stable learner statements. No source attribution is a legal or clinical signoff.
